/* selectQesitm(문항정보 조회) - Lee SangHoon */
SELECT T2.QESITM_MNG_NO , T2.QESITM_SQNCE , T3.QESITM_CN FROM SAC100 T JOIN SBB000 T1 ON T1.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = T.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 JOIN SBB010 T2 ON T2.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = T1.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO JOIN SBB200 T3 ON T3.QESITM_MNG_NO = T2.QESITM_MNG_NO
WHERE T.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND T.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = #{QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD} AND T3.QESITM_TYPE_SE_CD != '04'
ORDER BY T2.QESITM_SQNCE

/* selectEmtGhvr(정서행동검사통계) - Lee HysSun */ WITH X AS ( SELECT A.TRPR_INFO_NO , A.CASE_MNG_NO , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , C.QUSTNB_MNG_NO --설문지관리번호 , B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO --채점영역관리번호 , REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', ''), ' ','') AS QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM --채점영역고유명 , C.GRDNG_SCORE , A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , D.SRVY_ERA_SE_CD FROM SBB110 A JOIN SBB030 B ON A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO JOIN SBB500 X ON X.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND X.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO AND X.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = (SELECT MAX(SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO) FROM SBB500 WHERE QUSTNB_MNG_NO = A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO) JOIN SBB510 C ON A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = C.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO AND A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = C.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO = C.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO AND C.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = X.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO JOIN ( SELECT SBB600.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY INST_NO, TRPR_INFO_NO, QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO, SRVY_ERA_SE_CD ORDER BY REG_YMD DESC, MNG_SN DESC) AS ROW_NUMBER FROM SBB600 )D ON (A.CASE_MNG_NO = D.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = D.CASE_MNG_ODRNO) OR (A.TRPR_INFO_NO = D.TRPR_INFO_NO) AND A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = D.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND D.ROW_NUMBER = 1
LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q1 ON Q1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND Q1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN (#{QUSTNB_CD})
LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q2 ON Q2.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND Q2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN (#{QUSTNB_CD2})
WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO IN (Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2)
OR A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO IN (Q2.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q2.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2)
AND C.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO NOT IN ('SG2023013000126', 'SG2022102800009', 'SG2023013000123')
AND D.INST_NO = #{INST_NO}
AND D.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO}
AND TO_CHAR(X.RSPNS_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{BGNG_YMD} AND #{END_YMD}
) SELECT A.QUSTNB_NM AS RELM , A.LEVEL_CD AS SE_CD , A.LEVEL_NM AS SE , NVL(B.NMPR, 0) AS BEF_NOPE , NVL(C.NMPR, 0) AS AFT_NOPE , NVL(B.NMPR, 0) + NVL(C.NMPR, 0) AS NOPE , NVL(B.CNTNMPR, 0) + NVL(C.CNTNMPR, 0) AS CNTNMPR FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.QUSTNB_NM , A.QUSTNB_RANK , B.LEVEL_CD , B.LEVEL_NM FROM( SELECT '전체' AS QUSTNB_NM , '0' AS QUSTNB_RANK FROM DUAL
UNION ALL
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', ''), ' ','') AS QUSTNB_NM , '1' AS QUSTNB_RANK FROM SBB000 A LEFT JOIN SBB030 B ON A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO
LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q1 ON Q1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND Q1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN (#{QUSTNB_CD})
LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q2 ON Q2.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND Q2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN (#{QUSTNB_CD2})
WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO IN (Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2)
OR A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO IN (Q2.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q2.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2)
AND B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO NOT IN ('SG2023013000126', 'SG2022102800009', 'SG2023013000123')
ORDER BY QUSTNB_RANK, QUSTNB_NM ) A CROSS JOIN ( SELECT '1GREEN' AS LEVEL_CD , '보통 수준' AS LEVEL_NM FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '2YELLOW' AS LEVEL_CD , '주의 수준' AS LEVEL_NM FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '3RED' AS LEVEL_CD , '위험 수준' AS LEVEL_NM FROM DUAL ) B ) A LEFT JOIN ( ( --전체 SELECT LEV , COUNT(LEV) AS NMPR , QUSTNB_NM , COUNT(LEV) AS CNTNMPR FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END AS LEV , '전체' AS QUSTNB_NM , QUSTNB_MNG_NO FROM X WHERE SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '01' GROUP BY QUSTNB_MNG_NO ) GROUP BY LEV, QUSTNB_NM ) UNION ALL ( --사전 SELECT CASE WHEN GRDNG_SCORE < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN GRDNG_SCORE BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END AS LEV , COUNT(NVL(CASE_MNG_NO, TRPR_INFO_NO)) AS NMPR , QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM AS QUSTNB_NM , NULL AS CNTNMPR FROM X WHERE SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '01' GROUP BY CASE WHEN GRDNG_SCORE < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN GRDNG_SCORE BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END, QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM ) )B ON A.LEVEL_CD = B.LEV AND A.QUSTNB_NM = B.QUSTNB_NM LEFT JOIN ( ( --전체 SELECT LEV , COUNT(LEV) AS NMPR , QUSTNB_NM , COUNT(LEV) AS CNTNMPR FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END AS LEV , '전체' AS QUSTNB_NM , QUSTNB_MNG_NO FROM X WHERE SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '02' GROUP BY QUSTNB_MNG_NO ) GROUP BY LEV, QUSTNB_NM ) UNION ALL ( --사후 SELECT CASE WHEN GRDNG_SCORE < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN GRDNG_SCORE BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END AS LEV , COUNT(NVL(CASE_MNG_NO, TRPR_INFO_NO)) AS NMPR , QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM AS QUSTNB_NM , NULL AS CNTNMPR FROM X WHERE SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '02' GROUP BY CASE WHEN GRDNG_SCORE < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN GRDNG_SCORE BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END , QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM ) ) C ON A.LEVEL_CD = C.LEV AND A.QUSTNB_NM = C.QUSTNB_NM
ORDER BY A.QUSTNB_RANK
, CASE WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%타인공격%' THEN 1 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%자기공격%' THEN 2 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%회피/퇴행%' THEN 3 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%규범/지시불이행%' THEN 4 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%중독%' THEN 5 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%기타문제행동-훔치기%' THEN 6 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%기타문제행동-성문제%' THEN 7 END
, CASE WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%범불안장애%' THEN 1 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%공황발작%' THEN 2 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%PTSD%' THEN 3 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%우울장애%' THEN 4 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%분노조절%' THEN 5 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%피해사고%' THEN 6 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%신체화%' THEN 7 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%중독%' THEN 8 END
, LEVEL_CD

/* selectTrlEmtInsp(심리정서검사통계) - Lee Hye Sun */ WITH X AS ( SELECT A.TRPR_INFO_NO , A.CASE_MNG_NO , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , C.QUSTNB_MNG_NO --설문지관리번호 , B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO --채점영역관리번호 , REPLACE(TRIM(B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', '') AS QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM --채점영역고유명 , C.GRDNG_SCORE , A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , D.SRVY_ERA_SE_CD FROM SBB110 A JOIN SBB030 B ON A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO JOIN SBB500 X ON X.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND X.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO AND X.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = (SELECT MAX(SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO) FROM SBB500 WHERE QUSTNB_MNG_NO = A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO) JOIN SBB510 C ON A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = C.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO AND A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = C.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO = C.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO AND C.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO = X.SRVY_RSPNS_MNG_NO JOIN ( SELECT SBB600.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY INST_NO, TRPR_INFO_NO, QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO, SRVY_ERA_SE_CD ORDER BY REG_YMD DESC, MNG_SN DESC) AS ROW_NUMBER FROM SBB600 )D ON (A.CASE_MNG_NO = D.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = D.CASE_MNG_ODRNO) OR (A.TRPR_INFO_NO = D.TRPR_INFO_NO) AND A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = D.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND D.ROW_NUMBER = 1 LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q1 ON Q1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND Q1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN (#{QUSTNB_CD})
LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q2 ON Q2.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND Q2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN (#{QUSTNB_CD2})
WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO IN (Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2, Q2.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q2.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2)
WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO IN (Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2)
AND D.INST_NO = #{INST_NO}
AND D.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO}
AND TO_CHAR(X.RSPNS_DT,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{BGNG_YMD} AND #{END_YMD}
) SELECT A.FCTR_NM AS FCTR , A.FCTR_NO AS FCTR_NO , A.QUSTNB_NM AS RELM , A.LEVEL_CD AS SE_CD , A.LEVEL_NM AS SE , NVL(B.NMPR, 0) AS BEF_NOPE , NVL(C.NMPR, 0) AS AFT_NOPE , NVL(B.NMPR, 0) + NVL(C.NMPR, 0) AS NOPE , SUM(NVL(B.NMPR, 0) + NVL(C.NMPR, 0)) OVER(PARTITION BY A.QUSTNB_NM, A.FCTR_NO) AS CNTNMPR , SUM(NVL(B.NMPR, 0)) OVER(PARTITION BY A.QUSTNB_NM, A.FCTR_NO) AS BEF_CNTNMPR , SUM(NVL(C.NMPR, 0)) OVER(PARTITION BY A.QUSTNB_NM, A.FCTR_NO) AS AFT_CNTNMPR FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.FCTR_NM , A.FCTR_NO , A.QUSTNB_NM , A.QUSTNB_NO , B.LEVEL_CD , B.LEVEL_NM FROM( SELECT '위험요인' AS FCTR_NM , 'A' AS FCTR_NO , '전체' AS QUSTNB_NM , '0' AS QUSTNB_NO FROM DUAL
UNION ALL
SELECT '위험요인' AS FCTR_NM , 'A' AS FCTR_NO , REPLACE(TRIM(B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', '') AS QUSTNB_NM , '1' AS QUSTNB_NO FROM SBB000 A LEFT JOIN SBB030 B ON A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q1 ON Q1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND Q1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN (#{QUSTNB_CD})
LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q2 ON Q2.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND Q2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN (#{QUSTNB_CD2})
WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO IN (Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2, Q2.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q2.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2) AND REGEXP_LIKE (REPLACE(TRIM(B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', '') , '자기조절력|부적정서|빈약한대인관계기술|대인민감성')
WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO IN (Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2) AND REGEXP_LIKE (REPLACE(TRIM(B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', '') , '낮은자기조절력|부적정서|역기능적심리도식|빈약한대인관계기술|대인민감성')
UNION ALL
SELECT '보호요인' AS FCTR_NM , 'B' AS FCTR_NO , '전체' AS QUSTNB_NM , '0' AS QUSTNB_NO FROM DUAL
UNION ALL
SELECT '보호요인' AS FCTR_NM , 'B' AS FCTR_NO , REPLACE(TRIM(B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', '') AS QUSTNB_NM , '1' AS QUSTNB_NO FROM SBB000 A LEFT JOIN SBB030 B ON A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q1 ON Q1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND Q1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN (#{QUSTNB_CD})
LEFT JOIN SAC100 Q2 ON Q2.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'QUSTNB_KND_SE_CD' AND Q2.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN (#{QUSTNB_CD2})
WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO IN (Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2, Q2.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q2.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2) AND REGEXP_LIKE (REPLACE(TRIM(B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', '') , '자기이해및수용|긍정정서|진로계획및준비|일상생활자기관리')
WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO IN (Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1, Q1.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2) AND REGEXP_LIKE (REPLACE(TRIM(B.QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', '') , '긍정정서|삶의만족|자기이해|자기수용|스트레스관리기술|욕구충족기회|진로결정수준|자기관리')
) A CROSS JOIN ( SELECT '1GREEN' AS LEVEL_CD , '보통 수준' AS LEVEL_NM FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '2YELLOW' AS LEVEL_CD , '주의 수준' AS LEVEL_NM FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '3RED' AS LEVEL_CD , '위험 수준' AS LEVEL_NM FROM DUAL ) B ) A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT LEV , FCTR_NM , FCTR_NO , QUSTNB_NM , QUSTNB_NO , COUNT(LEV) AS NMPR FROM ( --위험요인 전체 SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END AS LEV , '위험요인' AS FCTR_NM , 'A' AS FCTR_NO , '전체' AS QUSTNB_NM , '0' AS QUSTNB_NO , QUSTNB_MNG_NO FROM X WHERE SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '01' GROUP BY QUSTNB_MNG_NO
UNION ALL
--위험요인 SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END AS LEV , '위험요인' AS FCTR_NM , 'A' AS FCTR_NO , REPLACE(TRIM(QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', '') AS QUSTNB_NM , '1' AS QUSTNB_NO , QUSTNB_MNG_NO FROM X WHERE SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '01' GROUP BY QUSTNB_MNG_NO, QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM
UNION ALL
--보호요인 전체 SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END AS LEV , '보호요인' AS FCTR_NM , 'B' AS FCTR_NO , '전체' AS QUSTNB_NM , '0' AS QUSTNB_NO , QUSTNB_MNG_NO FROM X WHERE SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '01' GROUP BY QUSTNB_MNG_NO
UNION ALL
--보호요인 SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END AS LEV , '보호요인' AS FCTR_NM , 'B' AS FCTR_NO , REPLACE(TRIM(QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', '') AS QUSTNB_NM , '1' AS QUSTNB_NO , QUSTNB_MNG_NO FROM X WHERE SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '01' GROUP BY QUSTNB_MNG_NO, QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM ) GROUP BY LEV, QUSTNB_NM, FCTR_NM, FCTR_NO, QUSTNB_NM, QUSTNB_NO ) B ON A.FCTR_NO = B.FCTR_NO AND A.LEVEL_CD = B.LEV AND A.QUSTNB_NO = B.QUSTNB_NO AND A.QUSTNB_NM = B.QUSTNB_NM LEFT JOIN ( SELECT LEV , FCTR_NM , FCTR_NO , QUSTNB_NM , QUSTNB_NO , COUNT(LEV) AS NMPR FROM ( --위험요인 전체 SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END AS LEV , '위험요인' AS FCTR_NM , 'A' AS FCTR_NO , '전체' AS QUSTNB_NM , '0' AS QUSTNB_NO , QUSTNB_MNG_NO FROM X WHERE SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '02' GROUP BY QUSTNB_MNG_NO
UNION ALL
--위험요인 SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END AS LEV , '위험요인' AS FCTR_NM , 'A' AS FCTR_NO , REPLACE(TRIM(QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', '') AS QUSTNB_NM , '1' AS QUSTNB_NO , QUSTNB_MNG_NO FROM X WHERE SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '02' GROUP BY QUSTNB_MNG_NO, QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM
UNION ALL
--보호요인 전체 SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END AS LEV , '보호요인' AS FCTR_NM , 'B' AS FCTR_NO , '전체' AS QUSTNB_NM , '0' AS QUSTNB_NO , QUSTNB_MNG_NO FROM X WHERE SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '02' GROUP BY QUSTNB_MNG_NO
UNION ALL
--보호요인 SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) < 60 THEN '1GREEN' WHEN MAX(GRDNG_SCORE) BETWEEN 60 AND 89 THEN '2YELLOW' ELSE '3RED' END AS LEV , '보호요인' AS FCTR_NM , 'B' AS FCTR_NO , REPLACE(TRIM(QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM), ' ', '') AS QUSTNB_NM , '1' AS QUSTNB_NO , QUSTNB_MNG_NO FROM X WHERE SRVY_ERA_SE_CD = '02' GROUP BY QUSTNB_MNG_NO, QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM ) GROUP BY LEV, QUSTNB_NM, FCTR_NM, FCTR_NO, QUSTNB_NM, QUSTNB_NO ) C ON A.FCTR_NO = C.FCTR_NO AND A.LEVEL_CD = C.LEV AND A.QUSTNB_NO = C.QUSTNB_NO AND A.QUSTNB_NM = C.QUSTNB_NM
ORDER BY A.FCTR_NO, A.QUSTNB_NO
, CASE WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%자기조절력%' THEN 1 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%부적정서%' THEN 2 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%빈약한대인관계기술%' THEN 3 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%대인민감성%' THEN 4 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%자기이해및수용%' THEN 5 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%긍정정서%' THEN 6 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%진로계획및준비%' THEN 7 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%일상생활자기관리%' THEN 8 END
, CASE WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%낮은자기조절력%' THEN 1 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%부적정서%' THEN 2 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%역기능적심리도식%' THEN 3 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%빈약한대인관계기술%' THEN 4 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%대인민감성%' THEN 5 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%긍정정서%' THEN 6 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%삶의만족%' THEN 7 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%자기이해%' THEN 8 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%자기수용%' THEN 9 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%스트레스관리기술%' THEN 10 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%욕구충족기회%' THEN 11 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%진로결정수준%' THEN 12 WHEN A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%자기관리%' THEN 13 END
, LEVEL_CD
